text:
Elisabeth: Heads-up — the /v1/embeddings API reference shows the response example using "vector": [...], but the runtime actually returns "embedding": [floats]. This is tripping up the Go snippet and the Python example tests.

Samir: Ah — thanks for flagging. Do you have the failing test/log?

Elisabeth: Yep, pasted from CI run: ```
FAIL: examples_test.go:42: got field "vector" not found in response
response body: {
  "model": "text-embedding-001",
  "usage": { "prompt_tokens": 12 },
  "embedding": [0.001, 0.23, ...]
}
```

Morgan: I can take a look. I suspect our docs generator mapping used the old name. Quick scan of the OpenAPI YAML shows the response schema still lists `vector` under components/schemas/EmbeddingResponse.

Kevin: FYI the SDK team already updated the Python client to expect `embedding` a week ago; the mismatch came up when the docs were regenerated from the outdated YAML.

Elisabeth: I opened a tiny PR that updates the example and the Go snippet to read `embedding` instead of `vector`: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 — it also updates the curl example and adds a note in migration.md about the param name changes.

Samir: Nice — can you add a one-liner in the breaking-changes section mentioning clients that parse by key name? Some users rely on exact keys.

Morgan: Will do. Also adding a unit test to docs build that verifies examples round-trip with the canonical response shape.

Kevin: Left a couple inline comments on PR 412 — mostly wording and an extra test case for empty embeddings. Once those are addressed we can merge. @docs-bot can you trigger a docs preview?

docs-bot: preview build started for PR 412 — https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/412 — logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/7890 :white_check_mark:

Elisabeth: I updated the PR with Kevin's comments and added the empty-array test. Also fixed the Go SDK snippet — changed `resp.Vector` -> `resp.Embedding` and updated the marshal example.

Samir: Approved. One more: the query param in the generate endpoint is `model` in the runtime but some examples use `model_id`. Can we canonicalize to `model` and add a small migration note?

Morgan: Yep I'll rename occurrences and add a redirect note in the docs so old links still point to the right example.

Kevin: After merge, let's cut a tiny docs patch release so marketplaces and external references pick up the fixed examples.

Elisabeth: Sounds good. Thanks everyone — I'll merge once the preview shows green and the ci badge is happy. :thumbsup:
